name: Somers Commons
summary: Somers Commons is a 134,732 square foot community shopping center located at the busy intersection of Route 6 and Route 118 in Somers, New York. Anchored by LEVEL FITNESS, TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY, and GOODWILL, the center serves an affluent trade area with over 2.1 million annual visits.
demographics: Somers Commons serves an affluent suburban trade area with a population of 33,814 within three miles, characterized by high household incomes averaging $178,157 and substantial home values of $593,157. The daytime population of 27,789 indicates a strong residential base with some commuter outflow. The center attracts upper-middle-class families and professionals seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs, fitness, and specialty retail in a well-maintained community setting.
description: Somers Commons is a well-established community shopping center strategically positioned at the intersection of Route 6 and Route 118 in Somers, New York, serving the affluent northern Westchester County market. Spanning 134,732 square feet, this open-air center attracts over 2.1 million annual visits from residents in one of the region's most prosperous communities. The property features a diverse tenant mix anchored by LEVEL FITNESS, TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY, and GOODWILL, providing a balanced combination of fitness, specialty retail, and value-oriented shopping options. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT, Somers Commons benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in the property. The center's convenient location at a major intersection, combined with the area's strong demographics including average household incomes exceeding $178,000, makes it a vital retail destination for the surrounding community.
